# GanttLegendShape

`Flare.Components.Gantt.GanttLegendShape`

What a legend sample is drawn as: the same element the chart draws, so it takes the same look.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Bar` | `0` | An item bar of the kind. |
| `Segment` | `1` | A segment of the kind over a bar of BarKind. |
| `Suggested` | `2` | A suggested (ghost) bar. |
| `Region` | `3` | A region of the kind. |
| `Cell` | `4` | A value cell of the kind. |
